brief: round-3 builder for W1-15 stealth/theft/crime/justice — verify and fix four live defects other pieces found this session, plus a scoped, low-risk pass at the round-2 verdict's biggest_gap
contention: sustained 18-42 headless_shell / loadavg 15-28 for the entire dispatch — never dropped below 8. Static/data work done first per rule 21; live verification taken in short single-browser windows (boot-check, stl-probe are module-level and browser-light; two stl-live.mjs attempts, first killed by a 240s timeout under load, second completed clean).

defects_verified_and_fixed.id: A — save blob path never clears stealth civilians/searches
defects_verified_and_fixed.declared_by: W1-SOULS-r3 status file, 'FIFTH, REPORTED NOT FIXED'
defects_verified_and_fixed.root_cause: engine.js Engine._sessionObservers()'s 'stealth' row had save:null with a why_not explaining applySave() restores crime.ledger+crime.zones only; resetSubsystem() (the named-state clear) could not be reused on the save boundary because it also re-news this.crime/this.zones, which applySave() had just restored one statement earlier.
defects_verified_and_fixed.fix: game/src/sim/stealth/system.js: new resetSessionEphemera() — the same clear as resetSubsystem() minus crime/zones, plus a reconciliation of every property object's stolen_from against the crime.stolenRegistry applySave() just restored (this.property is one shared in-memory object for the whole session, never rebuilt by sim.reset()). Wired as the 'stealth' row's save handler in engine.js _sessionObservers().
defects_verified_and_fixed.verified: node --check clean; boot-check PASS; stl-probe 125/125 unaffected (module-level, no browser state); live save/load round trip not independently re-driven this round beyond stl-live.mjs's own save-path assertions (see below) — a dedicated civilians-survive-a-load probe was not written; flagged for the critic.

defects_verified_and_fixed.id: B — fencing pays into a different purse from the one the save writes (and the bribe/answerArrest paths)
defects_verified_and_fixed.found_state: W1-16 (progression) had ALREADY landed Engine._setGold()/_gold() ('THE ONE PURSE') and routed fenceSell/bribeWitness through it, concurrently with this dispatch — verified by reading, not assumed.
defects_verified_and_fixed.residual_bug_found_and_fixed: engine.js answerArrest()'s 'pay' branch still did `st.p.gold -= bounty` directly. sim/stealth/system.js syncFromCharacter() (also W1-16's) re-heals p.gold from sim.progression.gold every frame, so that deduction was invisible one frame later: paying off a bounty at the guard cost nothing against the purse the save actually writes. Fixed to `this._setGold(this._gold() - bounty)`.
defects_verified_and_fixed.verified: node --check clean; boot-check PASS; stl-probe's CRM01/CRM02/theft/fence assertions (125/125) unaffected since they exercise the pure modules, not this Engine method directly — a live answerArrest('pay') probe was not separately re-driven this round; flagged for the critic.

defects_verified_and_fixed.id: C — shop hours flip trespass on some zones but not others, between noon and 3 a.m.
defects_verified_and_fixed.root_cause: tools/world/build-settlements.mjs builds one 'dwelling'-kind interior per household head straight off that household's own property zones (build-property.mjs), with `kind: 'dwelling'` HARDCODED regardless of the household's trade. 6 of ~112 households (smith/trader/apothecary, one each in archon/blackrose/gideon/helstrom/stormhold x2) have a trade room classed `shop_closed` in property data but got folded into a plain-dwelling interior, whose default hours (0-24, always open) meant `trespass({class:'shop_closed'}, {shopOpen})` was unconditionally false — 12 of 66 shop_closed zones could never be trespassed at any hour. Only surfaced once W1-04-r2 wired isOpenNow() into trespassCheck() for real this session; nothing read the field before that.
defects_verified_and_fixed.fix: tools/world/build-settlements.mjs: the dwelling open_h/close_h default now checks whether any zone actually inside that interior is class shop_closed, and uses shop hours (8-19) instead of dwelling hours (0-24) if so. Regenerated game/data/world/interiors/*.json and settlements/*.json.
defects_verified_and_fixed.verified: MEASURED directly, statically: all 66/66 shop_closed zones now flip open/closed between noon and 3 a.m. (was 54/66). node tools/check-data.mjs clean (558 files). node tools/analysis/crime-audit.mjs 37/37, TRS-1..4 unchanged. M14 mesh-overlap check (build-settlements.mjs's own gate) still passes at 0%. MEASURED LIVE, in the running build, on the exact zone this defect was diagnosed on: H.trespassCheck('archon.smith2.r0', {}) at 03:00 returns {derived_shop_open:false, trespassing:true, zone_class:'shop_closed'} — that zone was the one that could never trespass before this fix.

defects_verified_and_fixed.id: D — nobody is outdoors at 3 a.m. for stealth purposes; no NPC is a target to sneak past
defects_verified_and_fixed.found_state: W1-04-r2 (same session) already made sim.npcs walk and stand outside at night (16-23 outdoors at 03:00, tools/world/build-street-life.mjs). But that is a RENDERING/schedule population, not a STEALTH one: stealth's civilians[]/witness/perception kernel only ever populated from spawnCivilian() — a scenario/harness verb nothing in the running province calls. RI-MTH07's coupling for civilians was built and measured entirely against hand-spawned fixtures; the open world had a witness predicate with nobody in front of it.
defects_verified_and_fixed.fix: game/src/sim/stealth/system.js: new syncCiviliansFromWorld(sim), called at the top of step() before anything reads civilians[]. Mirrors PRESENT sim.npcs within 40 m of the player into civilians[] (tagged _worldDerived so scenario-spawned civilians/guards, which every RI-STL01/RI-CRM01 probe drives, are never touched, duplicated or removed). sim/step.js already runs stepSettlement then stepNPCs immediately before the stealth step, so positions are this frame's answer.
defects_verified_and_fixed.verified: node --check clean; boot-check PASS; confirmed by static read that arena_flat.json (the fixture every stl-probe/crime-audit scenario uses) does not call populateSettlement, so sim.npcs is empty there and the sync is a no-op — existing 125/125 + 37/37 assertions are unaffected by construction, not just by re-running them. MEASURED LIVE: loaded town-archon, set the clock to 03:00, stepped 30 frames, called H.listCivilians() — it returns real world people (e.g. eid 'archon-keeper-apothecary', civ_state CALM, los true, dist_m 22.99, a live pos/yaw), not an empty array. Before this fix listCivilians() was always [] outside a scenario that hand-called spawnCivilian().

round2_biggest_gap_scoped_partial_fix.gap: GAP-W1-crime-enforcement-is-a-free-win — guard_legion cannot attack (ai:'hold_ground', combat/enemy.js only scripts ai==='scripted') and its parley surrendered for free (gold_price 0, base_disposition 35 already clears the GOLD ground's disposition>=20 floor).
round2_biggest_gap_scoped_partial_fix.what_this_round_did: game/data/combat/enemies/guard_legion.json: gold_price 0 -> 300 (the round-2 verdict's own stated floor is >=200 g), with a gold_price_note explaining exactly what is and is not closed.
round2_biggest_gap_scoped_partial_fix.why_not_the_rest: The other two legs of the verdict's own remedy are cross-piece: (1) raising the GOLD ground's disposition floor from 20 to 40 FOR GUARDS SPECIFICALLY needs a code change in combat/parley.js, whose testGround('GOLD') threshold is shared by every parleying NPC in the data (inf_trash, cst_sap_speaker, etc.) — changing it needs re-verification across the whole roster, not just guard_legion. (2) making the guard actually swing needs real enemy AI, which does not exist in this build for any archetype ('scripted' is a scenario-file action-list player, not autonomous combat) — the round-2 verdict itself names this W1-12's ('enemy behaviour'), and W1-12 was one of nine agents concurrently active on combat/enemy.js this same session. Touching either under sustained contention, without the ability to run a full live regression, was judged too risky for this dispatch; documented rather than half-fixed.
round2_biggest_gap_scoped_partial_fix.verified: python3 json.load clean; node tools/check-data.mjs clean.

not_measured_this_round: A dedicated live probe for defect A (civilians/searches/pending actually empty after a real loadState(blob) round trip) and defect B (answerArrest('pay') actually debiting sim.progression.gold) were not separately written and driven — the fixes are read-verified against the exact mechanism the r2/W1-SOULS findings named, and boot-check + the full static suites pass, but a critic should drive both directly, not take this builder's word.
The round-2 biggest_gap's guard-attacks-back and surrender-routes-to-arrest legs — explicitly not attempted this round, see round2_biggest_gap_scoped_partial_fix.

stl-live.mjs's full 29-assertion suite did not complete under this session's contention: two attempts, the first killed by a 240s timeout, the second reached 18/18 clean live PASSes (crouch, light falloff/dark-coverage/snuff, the RI-STL01 §2 worked-row formula, both V clamps, the sound-radius range, property/ownership data, a tier-3 lock) with ZERO regressions before stalling on the lock-press stepping loop under 48 concurrent headless_shell processes and being killed to free resources. Defects C and D were instead confirmed directly and live with a small targeted script (see their verified fields) rather than via the full suite.
next_step: A fresh-context critic should: (1) drive a real loadState(blob) round trip with civilians/a search/a pending report live beforehand and assert all three are empty after the load, with crime.ledger/stolen_registry intact; (2) drive answerArrest('pay') and assert sim.progression.gold (not just sim.stealth.p.gold) actually decreases and survives a save round trip; (3) re-run stl-live.mjs and w1-15-coupling.mjs in full now that contention has (hopefully) dropped, to get the remaining ~11 assertions this round could not complete.
notes_for_successor: This session's git tree was under EXTREME, sustained concurrent write pressure (dozens of agents banking work at once) for the entire dispatch. One mid-session Read showed sim/stealth/system.js reverted to a version predating even a DIFFERENT concurrent agent's (W1-16's) uncommitted edit — a transient race in the shared working tree, not a real loss: a fresh Read moments later showed all edits (mine and W1-16's) intact, and they have stayed intact through every check since. If you see a file you just edited apparently missing your change, re-Read it before assuming it is gone — grep the working tree directly rather than trusting a stale tool-result echo. Also carried forward from W1-15-r2's own notes: Engine.stepFrames() renders one frame per sim frame unless H.setRenderRate(0) is set first, and setEntityPos()/queueInputs() have the yaw/relative-frame traps documented there.
